verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs describe granular control over subscription changes—timing, proration behavior, credits, charges, discounts, and trial handling (recurly-docs-16, recurly-docs-1, recurly-docs-2)—and credit invoices that are separately tracked with a 'full audit trail' (recurly-docs-9, recurly-docs-22), plus post-issuance invoice edits for record accuracy (recurly-docs-10, recurly-docs-21). This supports the core of the proration/credit/audit story, but there's no worked numerical example or third-party verification showing invoices reconciling exactly to the penny. Missing for 10: a documented worked proration calculation example, independent/hands-on confirmation of penny-accurate reconciliation, and finance-specific audit reporting details beyond general 'audit trail' language.
